{{Top|leg}}
A '''power cycler''' was a system on some [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]. Enhanced power cyclers were built into the [[AG-2G quad laser cannon/Legends|AG-2G quad laser cannons]] fitted on the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] and were used alongside high-volume [[Blaster gas/Legends|gas]] feeds and custom-modified [[Laser actuator/Legends|laser actuators]] with larger [[Energization crystal/Legends|energization crystals]] to increase the weapon's energy output.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
